title: archangelica brevicaulis
intro: Archangelica brevicaulis, commonly known as Wild Angelica, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae) native to Europe and Asia. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Wild Angelica include reducing fever, relieving digestive issues, and calming the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Wild Angelica include sesquiterpenes, volatile oils, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
